test_accounting: 4946 full default core unit tests + 144 selected core integration tests + 8 CLI tests. The transient discovery probe and the publication ledger rerun are excluded; the latter repeats three tests already included in the unit suite.

implementation.admission: Missing ordinary braced, bare and signed parameter references retain a scoped definition in both expression dialects. Syntax/domain errors remain errors according to existing dialect semantics; ngspice ordinary parameters stay static while Xyce runtime definitions remain symbolic.
implementation.sampling: Shared forward-reference detection avoids context snapshots for known scalar expressions. Expressions that might reference unavailable bindings are first evaluated using an isolated random counter. Successful authored evaluation consumes the live stream once; failed probes and ignored duplicates do not consume it.
implementation.origins: Selected retained ordinary/global definitions keep independent physical source locations. Redefinition and numeric/string binding retire stale metadata; merges and global materialization preserve live owners. Continuations use the logical card start, matching existing parser origin semantics.
implementation.model_phase: Ordinary static parameter finalization now precedes static model expression folding. Model preparation no longer samples an ordinary forward parameter in a temporary shared-random clone and then samples it again in the returned netlist.

independent_oracles: Complex dependency and alias cases yield ambient=84 C; a 1 mA current through an 84 ohm root/local resistor yields 0.084 V.
An independent seed-37 stream fixes the eager draw, exactly one deferred sample, shared TEMP/TNOM/model reads, and the next untouched draw, including a missing dependency hidden in a user function.
UseFirst/UseLast select independently computed 10+draw and 20+draw values; warning/error policies and authoritative error origins are checked independently from selection.
Missing/cyclic parameters, malformed expressions and ngspice division by zero remain errors. Default-temperature arithmetic gives 58+27=85, while unbound ngspice TIME/FREQ remain invalid.

limitations: All 15 plan packages remain unfinished. Control dispatch remains 5/29; table control, result documents/adapters and option precedence still need integration.

General dependency planning is incomplete. Eager analysis cards, deferred source specifications, incomplete enclosing scopes and provisional-temperature domain errors remain in scope as recorded by the route probe.

This batch does not qualify complete ngspice/Xyce declaration sorting, all statistical/global/model consumers, parameter sensitivity propagation, every parser depth or every expression language feature.
Structural validation still uses behavioral preparation. Whole-run allocation limits, inner-operation cancellation latency and throughput/peak-memory gates are not established by these tests.
Three existing native unit tests remain ignored. Selected integrations and optimized WASM execution do not cover every analysis, model, feature or platform.
